one_liner: Cloud communications platform providing APIs for SMS, voice, video, and user authentication (2FA).
auth_notes: Supports JWT and Basic authentication depending on the product, using API Key and API Secret.
gate_notes: Free developer account creation allows access to sandbox and initial API credentials.
verdict_reason: Vonage offers robust, well-documented REST APIs with self-serve developer access supporting standard API Key, Basic, and JWT auth.

evidence.quote: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: Messages supports both JWT and Basic authentication
